Thanks for sharing your opinion. YouTube has already made its judgment, and comments like this only disrupt what we’re building. Even one view doesn’t have to be something a real person chooses to do if they genuinely dislike the content. Anyone paying attention can understand what’s really going on.

If you enjoy the channel, subscribe, like, and share. If you don’t, you’re welcome to move on—we don’t need to be everyone’s cup of tea.

replies.text:
Calling us “content thieves” doesn’t make it true. YouTube has already reviewed this through its formal process, and repeatedly showing up just to attack our channel is harassment, not constructive criticism. Anyone willing to look at the facts can understand what’s really going on.

If you enjoy the documentaries, subscribe, like, and share. If you don’t, you’re free to move on — this kind of behavior isn’t welcome here.

replies.author: @TruePlanetOffical
replies.text: Before repeating accusations, take a minute to learn how YouTube’s copyright process actually works. Don’t just take someone else’s word for it — do your own homework. There are always two sides to a story.
